dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: *sigh* What are we going to do about this?

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: There's something terribly wrong in Fontaine, that's what! Something's got to change, and we're all responsible for making that happen! We have to band together and fight for our rights!

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: Work? Why, I'm doing something far more important than work!

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: Those who always work and work will find themselves little different from clockwork machines. It is only through constant questioning and asking that we can forge a new path!

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: Our history and present are all proof of this.

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: If you do not mind treating me to a cup of coffee, we can continue this line of conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you talking about, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: Fontaine, of course, Fontaine! The Palais Mermonia, our energy situation, our top-down system... We have so many problems here. Can't you see?

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: I've spoken to Arouet about them many times, and he agrees with my points — why, he's even treated me to coffee several times!

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: It's just that... Well, that hasn't worked as well recently. He says that my opinions don't attract him the way they used to.
